reference_definition: geographic distance + habitat similarity + frozen nuisance structure
candidate_definition: reference plus frozen graph-connected versus alternative source relation
scoring_rule: predeclared genetic source-affinity contrast under the frozen geographic/environmental null
uncertainty_rule: predeclared block-aware uncertainty with no post-outcome resampling changes
success_rule: graph-connected source affinity must exceed the frozen alternative-source expectation under the local design and survive the predeclared geographic/spatial null
primary_estimand: genetic affinity to graph-connected sources beyond geographic and environmental null structure

lane_specific.genetic_null: geographic distance and habitat similarity null with predeclared population-structure nuisance terms
